name: SK Hynix
day_summary: GAP UP, CRASH, RECOVERY — SK HYNIX (000660.KS) CLOSED ₩1,577,000 (+₩10,000 / +0.64%): TUESDAY'S KRX SESSION WAS THE MOST VOLATILE OF THE POST-EARNINGS PERIOD — A ₩147,000 (9.9%) INTRADAY RANGE THAT TESTED THE PRE-EARNINGS ₩1,550,000 THESIS-VALIDITY FLOOR AND ULTIMATELY CLOSED ABOVE IT. THE SEQUENCE: (1) GAP-UP OPEN TO ₩1,620,000 (+₩53,000 / +3.4% FROM MONDAY'S ₩1,567,000 CLOSE) AS THE KRX PRICED IN MONDAY'S US MARKET RECOVERY (SPX +1.48%, NASDAQ +2.22%) AND IRAN DE-ESCALATION NEWS THAT ARRIVED AFTER THE MONDAY KRX SESSION ENDED; (2) SELLOFF TO SESSION LOW OF ₩1,483,000 (−₩137,000 / −8.5% FROM THE OPEN) ON 'SOUTH KOREAN SHARES RETREAT ON CEASEFIRE UNCERTAINTY' — IRAN SITUATION REMAINED UNRESOLVED, DOMESTIC RETAIL PROFIT-TAKING FROM THE JULY 31 +29.95% RECORD RALLY, AND SECONDARY INSTITUTIONAL SELLERS EMERGING AFTER THE KOSPI CIRCUIT-BREAKER SESSION CREATED RESIDUAL VOLATILITY; THE LOW OF ₩1,483,000 BREACHED THE ₩1,550,000 PRE-EARNINGS REFERENCE LEVEL IDENTIFIED AS THE 'THESIS-VALIDITY FLOOR' IN THE AUGUST 3 DOSSIER; (3) RECOVERY TO ₩1,577,000 CLOSE (+₩10,000 / +0.64% FROM MONDAY'S ₩1,567,000 CLOSE) DRIVEN BY ADR ARB CONVERGENCE BUYING (SKHY US ADR AT ~$140 VS KRX-IMPLIED ~$114 CREATES AN ~22.5% PREMIUM — STRUCTURAL BID ON THE KRX SIDE) AND IMPROVING GLOBAL RISK TONE AHEAD OF RECORD US SESSION (SPX EVENTUALLY +1.79% TO 7,737 RECORD, NASDAQ +2.59% TO 26,585 RECORD — NEWS THAT ARRIVED AFTER THE 06:30 UTC KRX CLOSE). THE CLOSE OF ₩1,577,000 IS +₩27,000 / +1.7% ABOVE THE ₩1,550,000 PRE-EARNINGS REFERENCE — THE 'HAMMER' OR 'LONG-LOWER-SHADOW' DAILY CANDLE (OPEN ₩1,620,000, HIGH ₩1,630,000, LOW ₩1,483,000, CLOSE ₩1,577,000) IS TECHNICALLY A BOTTOM-FORMATION SIGNAL WHEN THE CLOSE HOLDS ABOVE THE PRE-EARNINGS REFERENCE. HBM4 THESIS UNCHANGED — NO COMPANY-SPECIFIC NEWS DROVE TODAY'S VOLATILITY.
long_pnl: Investors who entered on the July 30 framework BUY (₩1,322,000) have now gained +₩255,000 / +19.3% in the four-session post-earnings period. Investors who entered on July 31's close (₩1,718,000) are now down ₩141,000 / −8.2% after two sessions — the two-day correction (Monday −7.92%, Tuesday closes barely positive) represents the post-30%-day consolidation explicitly warned in the July 31 dossier. The pre-earnings close (₩1,550,000) was breached intraday (₩1,483,000 low) but held on a closing basis (₩1,577,000). The August 3 dossier identified ₩1,550,000 as the 'thesis-validity floor' — a close above ₩1,550,000 means the post-earnings re-rating remains intact on the framework's primary metric.
short_pnl: Shorts who entered at the July 31 close (₩1,718,000 cost basis) have gained approximately +₩141,000 / +8.2% in two sessions. The ₩1,483,000 intraday trough today extended the short thesis briefly below the ₩1,550,000 pre-earnings reference, which would have been a meaningful bear milestone if the close had confirmed below ₩1,550,000. Instead, the close at ₩1,577,000 held above the thesis-validity floor — shorts who targeted ₩1,550,000 as a profit-take level could not fully exit at target. The ADR premium (~22.5%) remains the structural ceiling on short profitability: for KRX prices to fall significantly further, the US ADR must simultaneously lose its premium, which hasn't happened.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — gap up, crash, hammer recovery

SK Hynix (000660.KS) closed ₩1,577,000 on 2026-08-04, up ₩10,000 / +0.64% from Monday's ₩1,567,000 close. The daily candle structure: open ₩1,620,000 (gap up +₩53,000 / +3.4%), high ₩1,630,000, low ₩1,483,000, close ₩1,577,000. Intraday range: ₩147,000 (9.9%) — the largest single-day range of the post-earnings period. The KRX session ran 00:00–06:30 UTC (9:00am–3:30pm KST), entirely before US markets opened. Tuesday's US session subsequently produced SPX +1.79% and Nasdaq +2.59% all-time highs — again arriving after the KRX closed.

### Post-earnings recovery scorecard (four sessions)

| Session | KRX Close | vs. Pre-Earn. (₩1,550K) | vs. July 30 Entry (₩1,322K) |
|---|---|---|---|
| July 31 | ₩1,718,000 | +₩168K / +10.8% | +₩396K / +30.0% |
| Aug 3 | ₩1,567,000 | +₩17K / +1.1% | +₩245K / +18.5% |
| **Aug 4** | **₩1,577,000** | **+₩27K / +1.7%** | **+₩255K / +19.3%** |

Note: Aug 3 close is recorded as ₩1,567,000 per market data sources (minor discrepancy with August 3 dossier's estimate of ₩1,582,000, likely reflecting official KRX closing auction vs. intraday quote). Framework analysis uses ₩1,567,000 as the August 3 official close throughout.

Key observation: two sessions after the July 31 peak, SK Hynix is still +₩255,000 / +19.3% above the pre-earnings trough and +₩27,000 / +1.7% above the pre-earnings reference close. The post-earnings re-rating remains substantially intact.

### Trend — 'hammer' reversal pattern above thesis floor; bottom-formation signal

The daily candle structure on August 4 is textbook 'hammer': long lower shadow (₩1,483,000 low to ₩1,577,000 close = ₩94,000 lower shadow), short body (₩1,620,000 open to ₩1,577,000 close = ₩43,000 body), minimal upper shadow (₩1,620,000 open to ₩1,630,000 high = ₩10,000 upper shadow). In candlestick analysis, a hammer pattern at or above a key support level (here: ₩1,550,000) signals potential bottom formation. The technical validity requires follow-through on the next session — a Wednesday close above ₩1,577,000 confirms the hammer; a close below the hammer's open (₩1,620,000) level would negate the pattern.

Larger trend context: SK Hynix is in a post-event consolidation phase after the July 31 +29.95% single-day move. The two-session correction (−7.92% Monday, +0.64% Tuesday net) is well within the normal range for post-30%-day consolidation — the July 31 dossier explicitly warned of this scenario. The correction has now reduced the two-day post-earnings peak-to-trough gain from +30.0% (July 31) to +19.3% (August 4) — still one of the largest four-session gains for a large-cap semiconductor stock in 2026.

### What invalidates the bull read

A KRX closing price below ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference) signals the post-earnings re-rating has been fully unwound — BUY thesis must be re-evaluated. A close below ₩1,450,000 (July 29 post-earnings bounce) would require a fundamental re-assessment of HBM4 demand (e.g., hyperscaler capex cancellation, Samsung shortage narrative reversed). A close below ₩1,322,000 (July 30 framework trough) would mean the entire post-earnings recovery has reversed — only possible with fundamental HBM4 demand deterioration or severe geopolitical escalation directly involving South Korea.
